title.zh: 将布基农省 Malaybalay 市 St. Peter 描笼涯的 Silae 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 St. Peter 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Silae National High School – St. Peter Annex in Barangay St. Peter, City of Malaybalay, Province of Bukidnon From the Silae National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as St. Peter National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Silae National High School – St. Peter Annex in Barangay St. Peter, City of Malaybalay, Province of Bukidnon From the Silae National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as St. Peter National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu St. Peter của Trường Trung học Silae Quốc gia tại Barangay St. Peter, Thành phố Malaybalay, Tỉnh Bukidnon khỏi Trường Trung học Silae Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học St. Peter Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต St. Peter ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Silae แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ St. Peter เมือง Malaybalay จังหวัด Bukidnon ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Silae แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา St. Peter แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus St. Peter, Sekolah Menengah Silae Nasional di Barangay St. Peter, Kota Malaybalay, Provinsi Bukidnon dari Sekolah Menengah Silae Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah St. Peter Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus St. Peter, Sekolah Menengah Silae Kebangsaan di Barangay St. Peter, Bandar Malaybalay, Wilayah Bukidnon daripada Sekolah Menengah Silae Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah St. Peter Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Silae National High School – St. Peter Annex in Barangay St. Peter, City of Malaybalay, Province of Bukidnon is hereby separated from the Silae National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as St. Peter National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Silae National High School – St. Peter Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the St. Peter National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the St. Peter National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Silae National High School – St. Peter Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
